{'text': 'Apple 已確認將於下星期二（10 月 13 日）舉行一場名為「歡迎回家」嘅特別產品發佈活動，但尚未透露會否同步發表主題演講影片。以下係目前已知嘅資訊。', 'target': 'Apple has confirmed a special "welcome home" product announcement event for next Tuesday, October 13, but has not yet revealed whether a keynote video will accompany it. Here\'s what\'s known so far.'}

{'text': 'Apple 至今尚未確認「歡迎回家」主題演講嘅安排，不過 Mark Gurman 表示將會有「網上影片發佈」。', 'target': 'Apple has not yet confirmed arrangements for a "welcome home" keynote, but Mark Gurman has indicated there will be an "online video rollout."'}

{'text': 'Apple 今年一改以往嘅產品發佈模式。MacBook Neo 就係首個例子，喺 3 月以一場實體傳媒「體驗活動」亮相，此前先以多日新聞稿形式發佈其他產品。', 'target': 'Apple has shifted its product announcement strategy this year. The MacBook Neo was the first example, debuting in March at an in-person press "experience event," following days of news releases for other products.'}

{'text': '而家輪到 10 月 13 日嘅「歡迎回家」發佈會，似乎同樣會有新搞作。', 'target': 'Now the October 13 "welcome home" event appears set to follow a similar pattern.'}

{'text': '同傳統活動唔同，Apple 暫時未將「歡迎回家」加入 Apple Events 專頁，YouTube 或 Apple TV app 方面亦未見有任何直播嘅跡象。', 'target': 'Unlike a traditional event, Apple has not added "welcome home" to its Apple Events page, and there are no signs of a livestream on YouTube or the Apple TV app.'}

{'text': '以上情況喺發佈前嘅未來幾日仍有可能改變，但目前一切跡象顯示，10 月 13 日將唔會有主題演講影片。', 'target': 'That could still change in the days leading up to the reveal, but current signs point to no keynote video on October 13.'}

{'text': '然而，Bloomberg 嘅 Mark Gurman 就話會有影片發佈。佢喺一篇報道另一場將於 10 月 27 日舉行嘅 Apple 發佈活動中提及：', 'target': "However, Bloomberg's Mark Gurman says there will be a video rollout. He mentioned it in a report on another Apple event scheduled for October 27:"}

{'text': '根據 Gurman 嘅說法（佢事先已準確披露咗 10 月 13 日呢個日期及活動以智能家居產品為主題），Apple 下星期將會有「網上影片發佈」。', 'target': 'According to Gurman — who previously correctly revealed the October 13 date and the smart home focus of the event — Apple will have an "online video rollout" next week.'}

{'text': '傳媒獲邀出席喺紐約舉行、於美東時間上午 9 時開始嘅「Apple 體驗活動」。因此，若當日有發佈影片，預計會喺該個時間同步上架，較過往主題演講嘅慣常時間為早。', 'target': 'Press are invited to an "Apple experience event" in New York starting at 9 a.m. Eastern. So if a video does drop that day, expect it to go live at that time, earlier than the usual keynote slot.'}

{'text': '我哋預期星期二將會有至少三款新產品亮相，詳情可參閱呢篇文章。', 'target': "We're expecting at least three new products on Tuesday, which you can read more about here."}

{'text': '你認為 Apple 會否為「歡迎回家」發佈主題演講影片？歡迎喺留言區告訴我哋。', 'target': 'Do you think Apple will release a keynote video for "welcome home"? Let us know in the comments.'}
